post.summary: Arm the skeleton refit ritual — countdown, quality-gated capture, freeze
post.description:
Arm the segment-fit calibration ritual on every live pipeline.

Each pipeline's fitter clears its learned bone lengths and enters the ritual:
a countdown (so the subject can get into view and hold still), a quality-gated
capture window (only consecutive good frames count), then a freeze that
re-anchors each bone's trust region on the captured length. Observe fitter state in WebSocket frames. The command returns 204 No Content.

skellytracker's host, GPUs (with device keys), runtime and loaded libraries, EP status and performance
recommendation, and the models of each live run (realtime, legacy and posthoc), for the metrics window.

The probes cache themselves per process; the loaded libraries are read again on each request, in the backend
process where the inference service runs as a thread, because they change once a session loads its EP.

relay is on (when it is off, only the issue form is offered).

post.description: The exact report file that "send" or the issue form hands in for these reports and this note.
The person's "send" of the file they viewed: it is kept in the outbox, then sent to the relay.
The person saved the file they viewed and opened the issue form: its reports count as handed in.

"Not sent": these reports are pending again (also when opened or covered, which clears the issue address)
and any kept outbox file that holds them, waiting to retry or not, is deleted.

get.description: What the quick check of one EP on one GPU would run, its estimate, and why a part cannot run here.

post.description:
Start the quick check of one EP on one GPU with the person's detector pipeline, in a child process.

Refused while other work runs (a pipeline, recording, connected cameras, a sync or export job) or another check
runs; follow it in `app_state.certification.run`. When it ends, `certification.items` shows skellytracker's
stored result and `certification.last_result` how it ended.

409.description: `pipelines-running` (with `gpu_held_by`: any work, not only pipelines), `quick-check-running`, or `cannot-run` (with skellytracker's `reason_code`)

delete.description:
Stop the running check; it ends within about a second, its report says `cancelled`, and the stored result of
the EP does not change.

get.description: What the start check runs on this machine: each package's checks, estimate, downloads and changes.

post.description:
Start the quick check of this machine: freemocap's own checks, then skellytracker's quick check of every GPU EP
with no reviewed row (field-test EPs included), in a child process. Refused like a quick check; stop it with
`DELETE /certify/quick_check`. Follow it in `app_state.certification.run` (no `items`); `start_results` says how it
ended, and `start_required` turns false once it ended other than by a cancel.

409.description: `pipelines-running` (with `gpu_held_by`: any work, not only pipelines) or `quick-check-running`

post.description:
Install the Windows ML package of one EP that is not installed; Windows may download it.

Refused while any work runs, a quick check runs, or another install or remove runs; while it runs every other start
is refused. Follow it in `app_state.certification.pack_run`; cancel it with `DELETE /certify/ep_pack`.

409.description: `cannot-install` (the EP is not missing, or skellytracker refuses it, for example a field-test EP with no opt-in), `pipelines-running` (with `gpu_held_by`: any work), `quick-check-running`, or `ep-pack-running`

post.description:
Remove the Windows ML package of one EP that this app installed; a package that was on the machine before stays.

Refused like an install. How it ended shows in `app_state.certification.last_pack_result`.

delete.description: Ask a running install to stop; Windows ML stops it when it can, and a remove runs to its end.

post.description:
Forward a UI-originated event to the telemetry client.

This is a no-op when the user has opted out of telemetry: track_event only
forwards to the skellypings client when it was initialized, which happens
solely when telemetry is enabled. The opt-in decision therefore lives in one
place (telemetry_config.json) and the UI does not need to re-check it.

useOutlierRejection.title: Useoutlierrejection
useOutlierRejection.description: If True, triangulation uses the subset-ensemble outlier-rejection method: for each 3D point, the algorithm triangulates with all cameras, then iteratively drops cameras to find subsets that lower the reprojection error, and returns an exponentially-weighted average of all candidate 3D points along with per-camera confidence weights. Robust to mistracked or partially occluded cameras at extra compute cost (combinations x n_points per frame). If False, triangulation uses plain DLT - fast, but a single bad observation can skew the 3D estimate.

minimumCamerasForTriangulation.title: Minimumcamerasfortriangulation
minimumCamerasForTriangulation.description: Minimum number of valid camera observations required to triangulate a point. Points seen by fewer cameras are returned as NaN. DLT is geometrically defined for >=2 cameras, but >=3 is recommended when use_outlier_rejection=True so that dropping a camera still leaves a well-conditioned solve.

maximumCamerasToDrop.title: Maximumcamerastodrop
maximumCamerasToDrop.description: Maximum number of cameras the outlier-rejection method is allowed to drop when searching for a better subset. Higher values explore more combinations (C(n_cameras, n_cameras - k)) and can recover from more simultaneous outliers, but cost grows combinatorially. Ignored when use_outlier_rejection=False.

targetReprojectionError.title: Targetreprojectionerror
targetReprojectionError.description: Target mean reprojection error, expressed in undistorted-normalized image coordinates (typical range ~[-1, 1], so ~0.01 ~= 1% of the image plane). Subset weights decay as exp(-5 * mean_error / target). Smaller values weight low-error subsets more aggressively; larger values produce a softer average. Also acts as the early-exit threshold: if the all-cameras triangulation already achieves this error, no subsets are tried. Ignored when use_outlier_rejection=False.

blenderExePath.title: Blenderexepath
blenderExePath.description: The Blender path chosen in Blender settings; null uses freemocap's best guess.

downloads.title: Downloads
downloads.description: The `name` of each download that the consent step listed; the start is refused when the current plan needs another one.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: `cancelled` for a check that a cancel stopped, else the reason that its progress gave (freemocap's), or null.
